sections.Profile:
The Black Gold pinball machine, released by Williams Electronics in 1975, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game with a unique oil-drilling theme. Designed by Steve Kordek, it features two flippers, two pop bumpers, four drop targets, and one kick-out hole.
